module.title: FISHPACK 4.1 separable elliptic PDE solvers
entrypoints: test/t*.f drivers, one per solver: blktri, cblktri, cmgnbn, genbun, hstcrt, hstcsp, hstcyl, hstplr, hstssp, hw3crt, hwscrt, hwscsp, hwscyl, hwsplr, hwsssp, pois3d, poistg, sepeli, sepx4
module.expensive_path: cyclic reduction (blktri, genbun and gnbnaux, pois3d) and the FFT-based Helmholtz solves on the discretized grid; cost grows with the grid and the number of reduction levels
module.rationale: The whole library is one module: one build (make, one static library), one test set, one scientific responsibility. FISHPACK 4.1 (Adams, Swarztrauber, Sweet, NCAR) solves second- and fourth-order finite-difference approximations of separable elliptic PDEs (Helmholtz, Poisson and general separable equations) in Cartesian, polar, cylindrical and spherical coordinates by cyclic reduction, with least-squares handling of singular problems and of coordinate singularities. It is vendored from the NCAR-Classic-Libraries-for-Geophysics container repository as its own codebase because the container holds five unrelated libraries that share no source; this one is packaged alone.
hazards: single precision by default; the darwin.dp references use -fdefault-real-8 and the single-precision build agrees to only 1 to 4 digits
FISHPACK90 in the same upstream repository is the same solver set behind a Fortran 90 interface (not vendored)

approval.human_ref: single-module default: the whole codebase is one module; no human decision at STOP 1, the cut is read in the source PR body at STOP 2
